reading.title: Physical Appearance 1: A short reading
reading.text: Maya and Omar describe people in a set of photographs. One person is tall, another is short, and a third is of average height. They use slim, stocky, and muscular for different builds. The teacher asks for neutral descriptions of visible features. They compare their sentences and avoid guessing anything about the people.
